summary: OMA filed a Form 6-K disclosing its AGM approved a Ps.4,900 million cash dividend (two equal installments by May 31 and Nov 30, 2026) and a Ps.1,500 million share repurchase reserve for Series B shares until the 2027 AGM. No price per share or premium is stated as this is a capital allocation event, not a tender offer. The board recommended these items as part of ordinary shareholder meeting approvals. The repurchase reserve allows open-market buybacks but no specific program terms are given; the capital return is financed from retained earnings. Observe whether OMA executes buybacks and whether the dividend signals ongoing cash generation discipline.
